notes.title: 😼Smashcat your enemies😼- play with Devs
notes.content:
[h3]February's Next Fest is on, so are our kitties![/h3]

[h3][b]The livestream play session of the [b]Catnight[/b] game will be held on Wednesday, February 23st at 10:00pm CET[/b][/h3]

[previewyoutube=ZaVB_Jvj_Hk;full][/previewyoutube]

The development team will be on hand to answer your questions and give you an insight into the game. Join us and tell us what you think. Help us improve the game. 

 😻[b]About Catnight[/b]😻   

[b]Catnight[/b] is an online multiplayer third-person perspective game that will heat up any party. You will not only fight with your opponents and the enormous amount of furry bullets in the air, but you will also need to survive special gameplay circumstances, which will make every match more dynamic and funnier.
